WSP Parsons Brinckerhoff and DNV GL (2015). Industrial Decarbonisation and Energy Efficiency Roadmaps to 2050: Food and Drink (main report and Appendices A-D). Prepared for the Department of Energy and Climate Change (DECC) and the Department for Business, Innovation and Skills (BIS), London, March 2015. No DOI or report number printed. https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/industrial-decarbonisation-and-energy-efficiency-roadmaps-to-2050

Locators are printed page numbers: "Report p.N" = footer of the 111-page main report; "App. p.N" = footer of the 121-page Appendices. UK, 2012 base year. The Appendix C register (Tables 12-17, 25 options) gives, per option, TRL, adoption rate, applicability, a CAPEX RANGE for a representative site and a sector-wide CO2 (or electricity) reduction; the options are generic measures (energy management, MVR/TVR, pasteurisation, drying, electrification, biomass, carbon capture) without equipment size or energy per unit, so all 25 are in _measures and none are in the main file. Main file (6 technologies): lifetimes (boilers at least 30 years, CHP and turbines about 20 years) and process temperatures (pasteurisation below 100 degC, baking oven 110-240 degC, CIP 50-90 degC). _other-values: sector energy and emissions statistics, end-use shares, other process temperatures, pathway capital costs. Not loaded: Appendix A/B methodology and enablers/barriers, Appendix D deployment charts, option descriptions (Tables 18-23). Traps: pdftotext glues footnote markers to TRL (waste heat recovery printed "67", probably TRL 6 + footnote 7; "4-88" = 4-8 + 8; "412" = TRL 4 + 12); baking temperature printed 110-240 degC (p.34) and 110-350 degC (p.36); price year not stated; capex given as ranges (two open ended "over 7,000,000").
